title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Caganayan, Municipality of Tineg, Province of Abra, To Be Known As the Caganayan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Caganayan, Municipality of Tineg, Province of Abra, To Be Known As the Caganayan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Caganayan, Thị trấn Tineg, Tỉnh Abra được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Caganayan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Caganayan, เทศบาล Tineg, จังหวัด Abra ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Caganayan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Caganayan, Kotamadya Tineg, Provinsi Abra dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Caganayan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Caganayan, Perbandaran Tineg, Wilayah Abra dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Caganayan

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Caganayan, Municipality of Tineg, Province of Abra, to be known as the Caganayan National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall implement this Act so as to make the national high school in operation during the first school year after the effectivity of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
